verdict.rationale: Claude is operated through natural language by design. Users chat on web, desktop and mobile to search the web, create files, run code, and hand off or schedule tasks. Developers get direct prompting through the Messages API and Managed Agents, and natural-language requests can drive computer-use, browser and bash tools. Community users report getting long lists of real work done through Claude Code with natural-language instructions. Missing for 10: no evidence that account and admin management (members, keys, usage) can be done by natural language rather than the programmatic Admin API, and no independent hands-on tests of the natural-language command interfaces beyond anecdotal comments.
